ev.q: gestational weight gain was within the recommended range for 32% of women giving birth to full-term, singleton infants in 2015
Weight gain above the recommendations was highest among women who were overweight (61%) or had obesity (55%) before pregnancy.
Approximately 44% of women who were underweight before pregnancy gained within the recommendations
